verdict.rationale: Trade-secret protection is a fair question for a full-service law firm with an IP practice. However, the IP page only documents trademark and patent work, and the employment and data-protection pages never mention trade secrets, confidentiality programs, employee-mobility or non-compete disputes, or trade-secret litigation. Those general employment-litigation and cybersecurity practices are adjacent services and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation
